adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired the missing activity layer by extracting primary-source MIC rows from PDF text and local OA figures, reconciled APD6 linked rows against sequence/activity evidence, and replaced placeholder mechanism notes with source-backed LptA-binding claims. The paper is publication-grade with cautions because APD6:AP05756 contains database activity not supported by the 2023 local primary material, several mutant full sequences remain database-derived from mutation labels, and no local hemolysis/cytotoxicity endpoints were reported.

Seven natural APD6 rows are source_verified from Figure 1/Figure 2 and source text; three mutant analog rows are retained as sequence_modified_not_normalized; AP05756 is preserved as source_conflict because its APD activity text is not supported by this 2023 local primary paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Seventeen primary-source MIC records were recovered from main text and figure images for E. coli ATCC 25922. No toxicity rows are emitted because local XML/PDF/DOCX/OA materials do not report hemolysis or cytotoxicity endpoints.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6:AP05756 sequence appears in Figure 1, but its APD6 activity text cites nonlocal/later activity claims not assayed in this 2023 paper.
No hemolysis or mammalian cytotoxicity endpoints were found in local XML/PDF/OA/DOCX materials.
Mutation/activity labels for AP05764-AP05766 are source-supported; full derived sequences remain database-derived and are not silently normalized as exact primary sequence text.
